_readme: Candidates only — the build never reads this file. Set each p yourself (0.01–0.99), set made to the day you add it, add a rationale if you like, then move the entry into forecasts.json. Board forecasts must be added before their metric.from date (Oct 1 for these). Their thresholds sit near the trend baseline's median as of 2026-09-29 — the baseline gives them roughly 35–45% — so your p is your disagreement with the trend.

forecasts.question: Will H.R. 10519 (Critical Infrastructure AI Cyber Defense Pilot Program) be marked up by a House committee by Dec 31, 2026?
forecasts.criteria: Congress.gov lists a committee markup or 'ordered to be reported' action on H.R. 10519 dated on or before Dec 31, 2026.

forecasts.question: Will CAISI publish a second public cyber-capability evaluation of an AI model by Dec 31, 2026?
forecasts.criteria: NIST/CAISI publishes, alone or jointly, a cyber-capability evaluation of a named AI model other than the Jul 23, 2026 Kimi K3 co-publication, dated on or before Dec 31, 2026.

forecasts.question: Will the U.S. government publicly confirm that any AI model has been designated a 'covered frontier model' under EO 14409 by Dec 31, 2026?
forecasts.criteria: An official U.S. government statement, or the model's developer on the record, confirms a covered-frontier-model designation under EO 14409 on or before Dec 31, 2026.

forecasts.question: Will the U.S. and China announce an agreed AI incident notification mechanism by Mar 31, 2027?
forecasts.criteria: Both governments, or a joint statement, confirm an agreed mechanism for notifying each other of AI incidents with national security implications, announced on or before Mar 31, 2027. A proposal or agreement to keep talking does not count.

forecasts.question: Will OpenAI or Google DeepMind restrict or reroute cybersecurity tasks for a newly released flagship model, as Anthropic did with Claude Opus 5.5, by Dec 31, 2026?
forecasts.criteria: OpenAI or Google DeepMind states on the record that a flagship model released on or after Sep 29, 2026 routes, refuses or gates general cybersecurity tasks for ordinary users differently from other tasks.

forecasts.question: Will a major software vendor other than Cisco attribute a CVSS 9.0+ vulnerability to AI-assisted discovery in its own advisory by Dec 31, 2026?
forecasts.criteria: A vendor's own security advisory, dated Sep 29 – Dec 31, 2026, credits AI or AI-assisted internal testing with finding at least one flaw it rates CVSS 9.0 or higher. 'Major' = a company on the Fortune 500 or Forbes Global 2000.

forecasts.question: Will the board log at least 125 Attacks items dated Oct 1 – Dec 31, 2026?
forecasts.criteria: 125 or more Attacks-lane items on the board dated Oct 1 – Dec 31, 2026, counted 7 days after the window closes.

forecasts.question: Will the board log at least 100 Capability items dated Oct 1 – Dec 31, 2026?
forecasts.criteria: 100 or more Capability-lane items on the board dated Oct 1 – Dec 31, 2026, counted 7 days after the window closes.

forecasts.question: Will the board log at least 40 Markets items dated Oct 1 – Dec 31, 2026?
forecasts.criteria: 40 or more Markets-lane items on the board dated Oct 1 – Dec 31, 2026, counted 7 days after the window closes.
